description: This file defines a React component 'PaymentsClient' for managing payments within a multi-shop billing system. It includes functionality for listing, filtering, paginating, creating, and deleting payments, and references back-end API calls via 'apiClient'. It also defines local helper functions for formatting currency and dates, managing form state, and rendering UI components such as tables, modals, and forms.

methods.name: formatCurrency
methods.description: Formats a number as a currency string based on the provided currency code, with fallback formatting.

methods.name: formatDate
methods.description: Converts an ISO date string to a locale date string; returns '-' if invalid.

methods.name: toDateInputValue
methods.description: Converts an ISO date string to 'YYYY-MM-DD' format suitable for date input fields.

methods.name: fromDateInputValue
methods.description: Converts a 'YYYY-MM-DD' string into an ISO date string.

methods.name: statusVariant
methods.description: Maps invoice status strings to visual badge variants.

methods.name: methodVariant
methods.description: Maps payment method strings to visual badge variants.

methods.name: PaymentsClient
methods.description: Main React component for managing payments, including listing, filtering, creating, updating, and deleting payment entries within a specific shop context.
